notes: Sheet drawn with State Avenue running NNE at the top and turning nearly vertical below y 5400. Names printed without suffix kept bare: DODSON, SHELBY, OSCAR, SARATOGA, WALLACE, DETROIT ('Not open'); JEAN is printed bare here but is Jean St. on sheet 491, LEHMAN R'D = Lehman Road, W. LIBERTY (IRON VIADUCT) = West Liberty Street, BOURGEOIS ST., KINEON AV., NEFF AV. Jean Street (from sheet 492) ends at Dodson; Shelby starts at Dodson about 240 px further west (the two are jogged, not continuous), so two T picks. Dodson only runs from Lehman Road to Jean Street; its T with Lehman Road falls just off the left edge (centrelines meet near x -170, y 2500), not picked. Shelby and Kineon Avenue are one continuous street line (house numbers run through, 1491-1502 at the first bend down to 1455/1458 at the bottom); SHELBY is printed on the upper diagonal part and KINEON AV. on the lower part, so the name changes somewhere between the bends at y 4913 and y 5812. Wallace is jogged at West Liberty Street: the north part (Saratoga to Liberty) and the south part (Liberty to the bottom edge, continuing on 494) are offset about one street width, so two T picks. West Liberty Street meets State Avenue from the east only (State west side is unbroken). The 40 ft cross street between Neff Avenue and Kineon Avenue (y about 6540-6740) has no name on this sheet or on 494; its west end at Neff Avenue falls at the scan edge (centre near x 15, y 6735, Neff's west line not drawn there) so only the Kineon T is picked. Detroit/West Liberty is under the iron viaduct span. The 'Street (No Name)' 60 ft along the right edge east of the railroad is unnamed and its meeting with Liberty is at or beyond the edge; not picked. Oscar and Saratoga house numbers both read 1380/1381 at their east ends.
